objective: Determine whether the canonical catchable task contains action-contingent interception headroom beyond passive transport, then implement but do not claim a capacity-matched bounded-sharing mechanism.
falsifier: The full-state action-feasible oracle fails to beat stationary transport after one bounded repair, the local policy fails passive/information controls, sharing is non-positive under equal capacity, timestep refinement changes the contrast materially, or 80% simulated power at a 0.01 effect requires more than 64 independent seeds.
smallest_unresolved_question: At fixed catchable dynamics, does a bounded shared team velocity summary improve passive-adjusted first-interception time relative to the identical-shape independent controller?
expected_information_gain: Separate task infeasibility, estimator failure, coordination failure, numerical instability, and insufficient power before any confirmation or MARL training.
dependency_gates: Verify the immutable SPS-P02 checksums and preserve its negative interpretation.
Add tested policy-use, path-length, valid-track, alignment, wall, absolute-time, and passive-adjusted diagnostics.
Implement a distinct full-state action-feasible interception oracle and pass deterministic microcases.
Run the bounded catchable-grid oracle/passive diagnostic; do not proceed scientifically if oracle headroom is absent.
Implement coupled Brownian refinement and test aggregation exactly before timestep interpretation.
Implement permutation-invariant bounded sharing and an identical-shape independent policy with leakage/equivariance tests.
Only after upstream gates pass, run the 8-seed shared-versus-independent diagnostic and simulation-based power analysis.
oracle_gate: Positive mean passive-adjusted gain and better absolute restricted first-contact time than stationary and true-field-only controls, with the expected direction in at least 6 of 8 seeds at one nonzero catchable grid point.
timestep_gate: For dt 0.02, 0.01, and 0.005 at fixed physical horizon and alpha, use finest-level Brownian increments summed exactly to coarser levels; provisional stability requires no policy-order reversal and a mean contrast difference no larger than 0.0025 between the two finest levels.
power_gate: Choose the smallest of 16, 24, 32, 48, or 64 independent seeds with simulated familywise type-I error at most 0.05 and at least 80% power for a 0.01 normalized-horizon coordination effect; otherwise block confirmation.
compute_cap: Codex cloud CPU only; eight diagnostic seeds; no learned MARL training; no HPC.
prohibited_actions: Do not reuse diagnostic seeds for confirmation.
Do not call the true-field upstream control an interception oracle.
Do not infer active exploitation from signal versus null alone.
Do not infer coordination from independent replicas.
Do not request HPC or train IPPO/MAPPO before every scripted gate passes.
no_reply_action: Continue reversible implementation, diagnostics, timestep utilities, literature, manuscript evidence constraints, and expansion updates; stop downstream scientific runs at the first failed gate.
